headline: Licensing applications for Los Compadres Restaurant, El Piloncito Supermarket, a complaint against Eleven Kitchen & Bar, and a liquor license transfer for Envy Lounge.
summary: The meeting will review new Common VIC license applications for Los Compadres Restaurant, LLC and El Piloncito Supermarket & Restaurant. It will also address a complaint against YH Enterprise INC DBA Eleven Kitchen & Bar and a tabled liquor license transfer request from Father & Son DBA Envy Lounge to Kathan LLC DBA Rumba Bar & Lounge.
items: New Business - License #VIC26-000033 - Los Compadres Restaurant, LLC applying for a Common VIC license at 107 Union St, former D'Lizardo Restaurant. Representing: Danny Ferreiras

New Business - License #VIC26-000032 - El Piloncito Supermarket & Restaurant applying for a Common VIC License at 179-183 Jackson St, former Bonanza Supermarket & Restaurant. Representing: Rosanny M Sanchez
New Complaint - YH Enterprise INC DBA Eleven Kitchen & Bar regarding new ownership, management, liquor license, and outdoor dining arrangements. By Commissioner Laird. Representing: Yoel Herrera

Tabled on 9/23/2026 - License #LL26-000039 - Father & Son DBA Envy Lounge applying to transfer their existing liquor license to Kathan LLC DBA Rumba Bar & Lounge. Representing: Marisol Rodriguez/Brian Corrigan
location: City Hall Chambers Room 105, 200 Common St, Lawrence, MA 01840
